patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff applied cleanly to the tracked fuzzing source and changed only the caller-side guard in `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`. On the original `%\xff` witness, the fixed build still reaches `free_guard` with `format_result=-1` but suppresses `free_sink`, and the nearest one-byte parser repair `escaped_percent_boundary` (`20 25 ff` -> `20 25 25`) executes `free_sink` genuinely with `format_result=11`, confirming the caller now frees `cmd` only on successful formatting.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the caller reads or frees `cmd`, the return value of `redisFormatCommand(&cmd, new_str)` must prove that the out-parameter write succeeded. A `-1` result means the caller must not use `cmd`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable fuzzer discards the return value and instead branches on `cmd != NULL`, so the failing `%\xff` call path still reaches `hi_free(cmd)` even though the out-parameter was not guaranteed to be written.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates this predicate at `free_guard` (`format_result=-1`) and still reaches `free_sink`. The fixed original is guarded on the same PoC (`format_result=-1`, no `free_sink`), and the nearest one-byte mutation `escaped_percent_boundary` executes `free_sink` genuinely with `format_result=11`.

nodes.description: The `hi_free(cmd)` sink receives the same caller-side pointer value that the cleanup guard selected; this is the project-side frame immediately above the crashing libc `free`.
The local out-parameter `cmd` is declared in `char *new_str, *cmd;` with no initializer, so any failure path that returns before writing through `&cmd` leaves this slot indeterminate.
nodes.evidence: Both vulnerable and fixed traces record `cmd_decl.zero_init == 0` at the declaration event.

edges.relation: The same caller-side pointer value read for the vulnerable `cmd != NULL` cleanup guard is passed unchanged into `hi_free(cmd)` at the sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original records `free_guard.cmd_value == free_sink.free_argument == 0x1`, and the `escaped_percent_boundary` case carries the same heap pointer across those two events on both versions.

edges.relation: The same local `cmd` stack slot declared at function entry is the slot whose address is later checked after the `redisFormatCommand(&cmd, new_str)` call.
edges.evidence: Each exercised case records identical `cmd_decl.cmd_slot` and `free_guard.cmd_slot` addresses within that run.
